promptTemplate: An archival medium-shot photograph of an alpine sanatorium pneumatic dispatch station mounted on {{mounting_surface}}, featuring {{tube_manifold}} controlled by {{routing_mechanism}}, receiving {{canister_shell}} distinguished by {{tactile_index}}, weathered with {{institutional_wear}}; no captions, titles, lettering or numerals anywhere in the frame

values.text: whitewashed limestone masonry weeping mineral salt efflorescence
scrubbed larch planks darkened by winter soot
glazed bottle-green vitrified ceramic sanitary tiles
pitted terrazzo panel flecked with granite chips
ribbed zinc damp-proofing secured with lead washers
bevelled milk-glass tiles set in bitumen mastic
split-faced gneiss ashlar mortared with river sand
vulcanized rubber dado panel scarred by gurneys
unreinforced concrete bearing rough timber shuttering grain
lead-backed acoustic felt clamped under iron battens
wax-sealed cork slabs pitted with condensation tracks
tallow-cured rawhide lining held by iron hobnails
dual drawn-copper conduits joined by ring flanges
matte-black cast-iron intake pipe wrapped in hemp
tarnished brass receiving tube terminating in dashpot
paired zinc pneumatic trunks linked by unions
nickel-plated intake shaft flared into drop chamber
triple bronze delivery conduits braced with yoke
vulcanized hard-rubber feed tube ribbed with steel
tin-plated pneumatic column sealed with wiping sleeves
massive vertical drop-column wrapped in bitumen tape
curved wrought-iron intake goose-neck with reinforcing ribs
paired cold-drawn brass tubes in stuffing boxes
antler coupling spliced into lead tubing
spring-loaded brass switch with ebony teardrop handle
counterweighted iron diverter lever in quadrant gate
knurled gunmetal bypass valve with index rim
forged-steel blast gate actuated by lead bob
sliding brass guillotine shuttles linked by gear
exterior bronze cam-plate driving twin follower pins
polished boxwood lever arm riding sector plate
slide-valve assembly driven by knurled rack
cast-bronze toggle fork dropping onto leather valves
routing pawl resetting against exposed helical spring
salvaged porcelain knob wired to iron toggle
weighted iron pendular bypass lever with horn
nickel-plated copper capsule ringed by rubber bumper
spun-brass cylinder reinforced with bronze wear-strips
opaque milk-glass ampoule encased in zinc cage
turned ash-wood torpedo capsule banded with iron
blued-steel canister fitted with brass nosecone
tinned-iron cylinder lined with bitumenized insulating paper
folded-sheet-zinc capsule joined by lead-soldered seams
vulcanized black ebonite tube with bronze end-caps
hammered pewter carrier shell bearing structural dimples
vulcanized fibre canister reinforced with copper eyelets
heavy cast-gunmetal torpedo capsule scarred by lathe
rigid drawn-lead carrier cylinder sealed with tin
baked-vermilion enamel bands ringed with copper rivets
diamond-knurled brass collar bearing filed triangular notches
cobalt-blue sealing wax stamped with hatch marks
five raised pewter annular ribs cast forward
braided emerald-green wool cord in knotted loops
two milled circumferential grooves inlaid with solder
punched round blind holes backed by fiber
cinched rawhide collar bands with lead tokens
alternating blued-steel and polished-nickel fluted rings
serrated brass band with six thumb-detent dimples
vulcanized yellow sulfur-cured rubber held by wire
stamped diamond detents filled with white gesso
streaks of dried carbolic acid bleaching metalwork
amber droplets of boiled linseed oil weeping
scuffed zinc corners and chalky lime-scour paste
dark greasy thumb-rubs polished into lever handle
green verdigris crusting along sweating tube joint
powdered sulfur dusting caught in flange recesses
chipped industrial lacquer exposing dull grey primer
heavy condensation droplets beading along intake collar
yellowish formalin splash stains running down timber
hairline impact dents and scratches around mouth
dried pine pitch sealing a hairline fracture
matte soapstone scrub powder lodged in crevices
